options.content: ● normal  ● warning  ● alarm  ● bad data  ·  ⌀ 30-day avg  ·  — off  ·  ⓘ details  ·  New dashboard for review: limits not yet set, so values show in white

panels.description: Permeating when the MBR permeate pump is running.

targets.query: SELECT last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_run_fb") AS "Plant" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.title: Plant

panels.description: Permeate flow (m³/h) integrated since midnight IST. The permeate totalizer is not used: it resets daily and reads about ×10.

targets.query: SELECT integral("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow", 1h) AS "Today" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" >= 0

panels.title: Treated water today

panels.description: Plant energy today (MCC power integrated) ÷ treated water today.

targets.query: SELECT integral("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_power", 1h) AS "kWh" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_power" >= 0
SELECT integral("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow", 1h) AS "m3" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" >= 0

panels.title: Energy intensity today

targets.query: SELECT last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_power") AS "Now" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("100_lit_06_lift_station_level") AS "Lift station" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("101_lit_07_equalization_tank_level") AS "Equalization tank" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.description: No membrane clean has been recorded: the CIP pump signals have never reported running, and the site does not use the membrane cleaning log form. Will show the time since the last clean once either is in use (the cleaning log form, as at Nanded and Zim Lab, is recommended).

targets.query: SELECT last("202_p_05_cip_pump_run_fb") AS "ran" FROM "plc" WHERE "202_p_05_cip_pump_run_fb" = 1 AND time > now() - 365d

panels.title: Last clean · MBR

targets.query: SELECT last("201_ait_01_anaerobic_tank_orp") AS "Anaerobic ORP" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("201_ait_02_anoxic_tank_orp") AS "Anoxic ORP" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("201_ait_03_aeration_tank_do") AS "Aeration DO" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("201_b_01_aeration_blower_power") AS "Aeration blower" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.description: Live membrane readings. TMP and permeability are shown only while permeating (flow above 1 m³/h); permeability shown in the PLC unit, LMH/mbar.

targets.query: SELECT last("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_lit_01_mbr_tank_level") AS "Tank level" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_calc_mbr_tmp") AS "TMP" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1
SELECT last("202_calc_mbr_flux") AS "Flux" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_calc_mbr_permeability") AS "Permeability" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1
SELECT last("202_tit_06_mbr_permeate_temperature") AS "Temperature" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.title: Membrane train

options.content:
not measured

targets.query: SELECT mean("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("202_calc_mbr_tmp") AS "TMP" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow" > 1 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("201_ait_03_aeration_tank_do") AS "DO" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.description: Fresh = readings in the last 5 minutes; Late = last reading 5–15 minutes ago; Stale = nothing for 15 minutes.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 15m

interval '30 days') AS entries_30d, count(DISTINCT (time_of_data_entry AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) FILTER (WHERE time_of_data_entry > now() - interval '30 days') AS days_30d, max(time_of_data_entry) AS last_ever, bool_or((time_of_data_entry AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) AS had_yday FROM weighment_data WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 191) GROUP BY form_id), s AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(f.title_override,''), f.name) AS form, COALESCE(e.entries_30d,0) AS entries_30d, COALESCE(e.days_30d,0) AS days_30d, e.last_ever, COALESCE(e.had_yday,false) AS had_yday FROM user_customform f LEFT JOIN e ON e.form_id = f.id WHERE f.is_enabled AND f.is_active AND f.team_id = 191) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE days_30d >= 20 AND NOT had_yday) AS "missed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE days_30d >= 20) AS "daily forms" FROM s
